## Activity

River Outreach recorded 49 captures during May 2022. This report summarises activity for the month and provides a brief account of image quality and grading outcomes. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall, the recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing the number of captures completed and the subsequent assessment of the images received.

## Image quality

Of the 49 captures, 9 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 18.4 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is noted separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. The image-quality outcome should be considered when reviewing the overall activity recorded for River Outreach during May 2022.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results among the graded outcomes. The median lag for grading was 23 days. This records the typical interval between the relevant capture and completion of grading, while the referable results identify the outcomes requiring further attention. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading information provides a concise operational summary for the month.
